items.period: Shang oracle-script style (modern vector redraw; file page does not identify a specific artifact date)
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 午 in oracle-script style, representing the early form discussed in paleographic accounts as a pestle-shaped graph.
items.alt: A modern vector drawing labeled 午 in oracle-script style.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons page identifies the graph and script style, cites paleographic sources, and provides public-domain reuse terms. It can illustrate the source interpretation, while remaining clearly labeled a redraw rather than an artifact image.
items.rights: Public domain; attribution appreciated but not required, according to the exact Commons file page.

items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 午 in Shuowen seal-script style; paleographic accounts describe the lower part as having become a horizontal stroke by the seal-script stage.
items.alt: A modern vector drawing labeled 午 in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Pairs an explicitly identified later script-style redraw with the oracle-style candidate to help explain graphic development. The underlying seal-stage form is supported by paleographic accounts; the SVG pixels were not inspected in this run.
items.rights: Public domain; attribution appreciated but not required, according to the exact Commons file page.

limitations.text: Both selected assets are modern vector redraws, not photographs or facsimiles of dated artifacts. The web tool could not render the direct SVG bytes, so pixel-level visual inspection was not performed; captions rely on the exact file pages’ identities and labels.
